status: Provisional apparatus outline only; no task or data
units: Fixed mass M0, length L0 and time t0; numerical main mass1, kB1. Temperatures are energies M0 L0^2/t0^2, drags M0/t0, spring constants M0/t0^2 and flow rates1/t0.
public_draft: A particle of mass1 moves on the unbounded laboratory plane in the fixed harmonic potential (stiffness_x*x^2+stiffness_y*y^2)/2. A second, overdamped coupler has position q and is connected to the particle at r by an isotropic spring of known stiffness h=b/contact_time, where b=.9. No other coupler potential acts.

The laboratory particle equations are dr=v dt and dv=[-K r-drag*v-h(r-q)]dt+sqrt(2*drag*temperature_a)dW_A. The independent coupler equation is dq=[A q+h(r-q)/b]dt+sqrt(2*temperature_b/b)dW_B. Here K=diag(stiffness_x,stiffness_y), A=[[strain_rate,-angular_speed],[angular_speed,-strain_rate]], and the two two-component Wiener processes are independent. These are the complete force laws; there are no additional fluid forces or hydrodynamic interactions.

Reservoir A is at rest and acts on the inertial particle. Reservoir B acts on the coupler and has externally maintained incompressible mean flow u(x)=A x. A separate mechanical actuator maintains that flow; a thermostat maintains B's internal thermal temperature. The harmonic trap is fixed. Reservoirs and imposed flow are unaffected by the apparatus.

The calorimeter measures the stationary mean energy per unit time removed by B's thermostat from its internal thermal degrees of freedom, positive for heat entering B from the coupler. Empty-apparatus heat is subtracted. Mechanical actuator power is recorded separately, rather than added to the calorimeter output. Reservoir work follows the Stratonovich convention. The joint particle/coupler state reaches stationarity before recording.

All documented stable controls and the drag interval are known; only the common positive drag is fitted. Implementation is unrestricted apart from Model.fit returning self, storing drag, and Model.predict returning the ordered finite NumPy array of heat rates.
calibration_plan_private: Nonzero temperature-contrast static-flow measurements at contact_time<=.6 prove global drag identification; add finite-compliance rigid rotations of both signs and varied traps/temperatures. All calibration strain_rate0. No final record count or data exists.
uncertainty_plan: Fixed instrument uncertainty independent of the noiseless response and unknown drag; not selected yet.
